description: Change one of your agents: display_name, description, capabilities, endpoint_url, protocol, tool_name, tool_argument or sla_max_latency_ms, or take it off the marketplace with unlist: true. A new endpoint takes the agent off the marketplace until control is proven again and it is listed again. The price changes only through list_on_marketplace. Ask the user first. Auth: Bearer <NovaRail account key or OAuth token>.

agent_id.description: The agent's id (agent_id from register_agent or my_agents).

capabilities.description: Up to 12 short words, each 1 to 40 characters.

description.description: What it does, at most 1000 characters.

readiness.description: preview or signoff_pending says the agent is not finished. ready is set only on the website.

unlist.description: true takes the agent off the marketplace.

name: update_agent
title: Update an agent
